n = int(input())
m = int(input())
mod = int(input())

MAX = 505

# Initialize combination table C
C = [[0]*(MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
for i in range(MAX):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % mod

# Initialize dp arrays
dpA = [0]*MAX
dpB = [0]*MAX
for i in range(MAX):
    dpA[i] = 0
    dpB[i] = 0
dpA[0] = 1

# Compute dpA
for i in range(1, MAX):
    for j in range(1, n+1):
        sum_val = 0
        for k in range(1, j+1):
            sum_val = (sum_val + dpA[k-1] * dpA[i - k] % mod * C[i-1][k-1]) % mod
        dpA[i] = ((i + 1) * sum_val) % mod

# Compute dpB
for i in range(1, MAX):
    for j in range(i):
        sum_val = 0
        for k in range(1, j+1):
            t1 = (dpA[k-1] * dpB[i - k] + dpB[k-1] * dpA[i - k]) % mod
            c = C[i-1][k-1]
            sum_val = (sum_val + (i + 1) * c % mod * t1) % mod

            t2 = (k*(k-1)//2 + (i - k)*(i - k + 1)//2) % mod
            sum_val = (sum_val + c * dpA[k-1] % mod * dpA[i - k] % mod * t2) % mod
        dpB[i] = sum_val

# Initialize dpC and dpD
dpC = [[0]*MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
dpD = [[0]*MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
dpC[0][0] = 1

# Compute dpC and dpD
for i in range(1, MAX):
    for j in range(i):
        v1 = dpC[i-1][j]
        v2 = dpD[i-1][j]
        for k in range(1, j+1):
            t1 = (dpC[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpA[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod
            t2 = (dpC[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpB[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod
            t3 = (dpD[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpA[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod

            v1 = (v1 + t1) % mod
            v2 = (v2 + t2 + t3) % mod
        dpC[i][j] = v1
        dpD[i][j] = v2
    dpC[i][i] = dpA[i]
    dpD[i][i] = dpB[i]

print(dpD[n][m])
